name: Morpho
purpose: Isolated lending markets in one immutable contract, each defined by loan token, collateral token, oracle, rate model and LLTV; MetaMorpho vaults allocate deposits across them.
about: Morpho Blue is a single contract with no upgrade path and no governance over existing markets. Anyone creates a market from five parameters (loanToken, collateralToken, oracle, irm, lltv) whose hash is the market id; the owner only chooses which rate models and LLTVs may be used, and a fee of up to 25% of interest. Supply and borrow positions are shares; interest accrues on each interaction. The oracle and the rate model are external contracts chosen per market. MetaMorpho is an ERC-4626 vault on top: a curator sets caps per market (increases behind a timelock), an allocator orders the queues and moves liquidity, and deposits are supplied to markets in queue order.

contracts.name: MetaMorpho
contracts.summary: Pools deposits of one asset and supplies them to Morpho markets in supply-queue order, up to each market's cap. Roles: owner, curator (caps, market removal), allocator (queues, reallocate), guardian (can revoke pending changes). Cap increases and other risk-raising changes wait for a timelock; it takes a performance fee as new shares.

contracts.name: Morpho
contracts.summary: One immutable contract for all markets: createMarket, supply / withdraw, supplyCollateral / withdrawCollateral, borrow / repay, liquidate, flashLoan, setAuthorization. Positions are shares per market; anyone can act for an account that authorized them. Callbacks let the caller act before paying.

pieces.name: setOwner()
pieces.desc: External entry point, only callable by owner. Gated by onlyOwner. Writes owner. Emits SetOwner.

pieces.name: enableIrm()
pieces.desc: External entry point, only callable by owner. Gated by onlyOwner. Writes isIrmEnabled. Emits EnableIrm.

pieces.name: enableLltv()
pieces.desc: External entry point, only callable by owner. Gated by onlyOwner. Writes isLltvEnabled. Emits EnableLltv.

pieces.name: setFee()
pieces.desc: External entry point, only callable by owner. Gated by onlyOwner. Uses _accrueInterest(). Writes market. Emits SetFee.

pieces.name: setFeeRecipient()
pieces.desc: External entry point, only callable by owner. Gated by onlyOwner. Writes feeRecipient. Emits SetFeeRecipient.

pieces.name: createMarket()
pieces.desc: External entry point with no caller restriction. Calls out to IIrm(marketParams.irm).borrowRate. Writes market and idToMarketParams. Emits CreateMarket.

pieces.name: supply()
pieces.desc: External entry point with no caller restriction. Uses _accrueInterest(). Calls out to IMorphoSupplyCallback(msg.sender).onMorphoSupply. Writes position and market. Emits Supply.

pieces.name: withdraw()
pieces.desc: External entry point, only callable by onBehalf. Uses _isSenderAuthorized() and _accrueInterest(). Writes position and market. Emits Withdraw.

pieces.name: borrow()
pieces.desc: External entry point, only callable by onBehalf. Uses _isSenderAuthorized(), _accrueInterest() and _isHealthy(). Writes position and market. Emits Borrow.

pieces.name: repay()
pieces.desc: External entry point with no caller restriction. Uses _accrueInterest(). Calls out to IMorphoRepayCallback(msg.sender).onMorphoRepay. Writes position and market. Emits Repay.

pieces.name: supplyCollateral()
pieces.desc: External entry point with no caller restriction. Calls out to IMorphoSupplyCollateralCallback(msg.sender).onMorphoSupplyCollateral. Writes position. Emits SupplyCollateral.

pieces.name: withdrawCollateral()
pieces.desc: External entry point, only callable by onBehalf. Uses _isSenderAuthorized(), _accrueInterest() and _isHealthy(). Writes position. Emits WithdrawCollateral.

pieces.name: liquidate()
pieces.desc: External entry point with no caller restriction. Uses _accrueInterest() and _isHealthy_2(). Calls out to IOracle(marketParams.oracle).price and IMorphoLiquidateCallback(msg.sender).onMorphoLiquidate. Writes position and market. Emits Liquidate.

pieces.name: flashLoan()
pieces.desc: External entry point with no caller restriction. Calls out to IMorphoFlashLoanCallback(msg.sender).onMorphoFlashLoan. Emits FlashLoan.

pieces.name: setAuthorization()
pieces.desc: External entry point with no caller restriction. Writes isAuthorized. Emits SetAuthorization.

pieces.name: setAuthorizationWithSig()
pieces.desc: External entry point with no caller restriction. Writes nonce and isAuthorized. Emits IncrementNonce and SetAuthorization.

pieces.name: accrueInterest()
pieces.desc: External entry point with no caller restriction. Uses _accrueInterest().

pieces.name: extSloads()
pieces.desc: External entry point with no caller restriction.

externals.name: IMorphoLiquidateCallback
externals.label: Caller callback
externals.summary: When the caller passes data, Morpho calls back msg.sender before pulling its tokens (onMorphoSupply, onMorphoRepay, onMorphoLiquidate …).

flows.title: Supply
flows.summary: Lend the loan token to one market and receive supply shares.

steps.say: Approves Morpho, then calls supply(marketParams, assets, shares, onBehalf, data) with exactly one of assets or shares.
The market must exist, exactly one of assets / shares is non-zero, onBehalf is not zero.
Brings the market up to now: interest since lastUpdate is added to both total borrow and total supply; the fee part is minted as supply shares to the fee recipient.
The market's rate model returns the borrow rate used for that accrual.
Assets to shares, rounded down (for a shares input, assets are rounded up).
Credits the shares to onBehalf, raises the market totals, emits Supply.
Only with data: onMorphoSupply is called on msg.sender before payment.
Last, the loan token moves from msg.sender into Morpho.

checks: State is written and the event emitted before the token is pulled; review that every path keeps that order and that a callback can't observe a half-updated market.
Rounding: supply rounds shares down, so a depositor never gets more than they paid for.
Integrations should pass assets or shares, never both, and read the returned pair.

flows.title: Borrow
flows.summary: Post collateral, then borrow the loan token up to LLTV.

steps.say: First supplyCollateral(marketParams, assets, onBehalf, data).
Credits collateral to onBehalf and pulls the collateral token. No interest accrual: collateral earns nothing.
borrow(marketParams, assets, shares, onBehalf, receiver). msg.sender must be onBehalf or authorized by it (setAuthorization).
Brings the market up to now.
Borrow shares rounded up, against the borrower.
Debt (shares to assets, rounded up) must be at most collateral × price × LLTV.
The market's oracle prices the collateral in loan token.
Total borrow must stay within total supply (liquidity). Emits Borrow.
The loan token goes to receiver.

checks: The oracle and LLTV are fixed per market at creation; an integration choosing a market is choosing its oracle. Review the oracle's scale (1e36) and what it does when its feed is stale.
Authorization is per account and covers every market; integrations that ask users for setAuthorization should say so.
Health uses rounded-up debt and rounded-down collateral value, in the protocol's favour.

flows.title: Repay
flows.summary: Pay back borrow shares; anyone can repay for anyone.

steps.say: Approves Morpho, then repay(marketParams, assets, shares, onBehalf, data). Repaying by shares clears a position exactly.
Market exists, exactly one of assets / shares, onBehalf not zero. No authorization needed.
Brings the market up to now.
Assets to shares rounded down (shares to assets rounded up), so repayment never removes more debt than paid.
Reduces borrow shares and the totals (total borrow floored at zero), emits Repay.
Only with data: onMorphoRepay on msg.sender, before payment.
Pulls the assets from msg.sender.

checks: Repaying by assets can leave dust shares; repaying a whole position should use shares.
Anyone can repay any position: integrations must not assume a position's debt only changes through them.

flows.title: Liquidation
flows.summary: Repay an unhealthy position's debt and seize its collateral with an incentive set by the market's LLTV.

steps.say: Calls liquidate(marketParams, borrower, seizedAssets, repaidShares, data) with exactly one of seizedAssets or repaidShares.
Market exists; exactly one input.
Brings the market up to now.
One price read for the whole liquidation.
The position must be unhealthy at that price.
Incentive factor = min(1.15, 1 / (1 − 0.3 × (1 − LLTV))); computes the other side of the trade, reduces the borrower's shares and collateral.
If no collateral is left, remaining debt is bad debt: removed from total borrow and from total supply, so all suppliers of the market share the loss.
Seized collateral goes to the liquidator.
Only with data: the liquidator's callback runs before it pays.
Pulls the repaid loan token from the liquidator.

checks: Bad debt is socialised immediately to the market's suppliers; vaults and integrations should account for a sudden drop in supply share value.
The incentive depends only on LLTV; review the constants (max factor 1.15, cursor 0.3) against the documented spec.
Every liquidation trusts one oracle read; review that oracle per market.

flows.title: Vault deposit
flows.summary: Deposit into a MetaMorpho vault; it supplies across markets in queue order.

steps.say: Approves the vault, calls deposit(assets, receiver) (ERC-4626).
First _accrueFee.
Total assets now vs last time; the performance fee on the gain is minted as shares to the fee recipient.
Shares rounded down, the asset is pulled from the depositor and shares are minted.
For each market in the supply queue with a non-zero cap: accrue, read the vault's current supply, supply up to the cap.
Inside try / catch: a market that reverts is skipped. If anything is left after the queue, AllCapsReached reverts the deposit.

checks: The vault's share price depends on every market in its queues; review each market's oracle, LLTV and rate model, not only the vault.
Skipped markets (try / catch) mean deposits can land in a different market than the first in the queue.
Curator and allocator powers: cap increases wait for the timelock, cap decreases and reallocations don't.

flows.title: Curate a vault
flows.summary: Raise a market's cap through the timelock, then let the allocator move liquidity.

steps.say: Calls submitCap(marketParams, newSupplyCap).
Only the curator role. The market must exist and lend the vault's asset. A lower cap applies at once; a higher one becomes pending until the timelock passes.
Stores the pending cap and the time it becomes valid.
After the timelock, anyone accepts it; the market is enabled and appended to the withdraw queue.
The allocator withdraws from some markets and supplies to others, within caps; total withdrawn must equal total supplied.
Liquidity leaves one market.
And is supplied to another.

checks: The guardian can revoke a pending cap during the timelock; check who holds guardian on each vault.
Lowering the timelock is itself timelocked; raising it applies at once. Check its current value.
Reallocation is not timelocked: the allocator decides where funds sit day to day.

flows.title: Create a market
flows.summary: Anyone opens a market from five parameters.

steps.say: Calls createMarket(loanToken, collateralToken, oracle, irm, lltv).
The IRM and the LLTV must be enabled by the owner, and the market must not exist. Sets lastUpdate and stores the parameters under their id.
The id is keccak256 of the five parameters.
Lets the rate model initialise itself for the market.

checks: Markets are permissionless: anything that lists or uses a market should check all five parameters, not just the tokens.
A market's oracle and IRM can't be changed later.
Per market: oracle (scale 1e36, staleness), rate model, LLTV; they are fixed at creation.
Shares maths: virtual shares and the rounding direction at each call site.
Callbacks run before tokens are pulled; integrations implementing them must check msg.sender is Morpho.
Vaults: curator, allocator, guardian and owner; which changes are timelocked and which are not.
notes: Mapped: Morpho Blue core and its libraries, MetaMorpho v1.0 and its factory. Not mapped: oracles (morpho-blue-oracles), AdaptiveCurveIrm (morpho-blue-irm), bundlers, public allocator, MetaMorpho v1.1 and Vaults V2.
